strings.zh: 战斗塔好高啊！{SCROLL}有我身高的多少倍呢？
strings.en: Battle Tower... It’s so tall!{NEWLINE}I wonder how many times my height it is?

strings.zh: 战斗前线的所有设施{CLEAR}都可以和同伴合作{CLEAR}进行战斗！{SCROLL}很棒吧？{NEWLINE}真羡慕{CLEAR}有伙伴的人啊！
strings.en: All the places in the Battle Frontier{NEWLINE}let you team up with a friend!{CLEAR}That’s so cool, don’t you think?{CLEAR}I wish I had a friend to team up with...

strings.zh: 我是城都最有名的{NEWLINE}超级偶像！{SCROLL}为了宣传新歌的活动而{NEWLINE}来到战斗前线的！{SCROLL}但是……{NEWLINE}聚集在这里的人们{CLEAR}大家都热衷于精灵！
strings.en: I’m the most famous super Idol in{NEWLINE}Johto!{SCROLL}I came to the Battle Frontier for an{NEWLINE}event promoting my new song!{SCROLL}But... everyone gathered here is crazy{NEWLINE}about Pokémon!
strings.notes: US 0100/2 | RV043: omission: restored 'most famous' and the promo event

strings.zh: 是这样的,{NEWLINE}当我听说了战斗前线的事情后,{CLEAR}虽然当时是在钓鱼,{CLEAR}心里也平静不下来,{CLEAR}所以赶紧收好钓竿{CLEAR}跑这里来了……
strings.en: You see, when I heard about the Battle{NEWLINE}Frontier, I was out fishing, but I just{CLEAR}couldn’t calm down. So I hurried to{CLEAR}pack up my rod and rushed over here...
strings.notes: US 0100/3 | RV043: meaning: stale US; he packed up his rod mid-fishing and came

strings.zh: 在５座设施中{NEWLINE}我最喜欢的是战斗城堡,{SCROLL}因为有嘉德丽雅小姐在那儿。
strings.en: The place I like best among the five{NEWLINE}facilities here would be the{CLEAR}Battle Castle, because you can see{CLEAR}Lady Caitlin there!

strings.zh: 我成为精灵训练家后{NEWLINE}感到最高兴的事情是……{SCROLL}通过精灵结识了很多{CLEAR}新朋友！
strings.en: What makes me the most happy being{NEWLINE}a Trainer?{SCROLL}The fact that Pokémon will always bring{NEWLINE}me lots of friends!

strings.zh: 和人活着会积累各种经验一样,{SCROLL}精灵经过不断战斗{CLEAR}会获得各种经验,{SCROLL}单单所经历的事情的数量{NEWLINE}就能成为故事了,老太婆。
strings.en: Just as people pile up all kinds of{NEWLINE}experience as they live,{SCROLL}Pokémon gain all kinds of experience by{NEWLINE}battling again and again.{SCROLL}The sheer number of things they’ve{NEWLINE}been through could make a{CLEAR}story, old girl.
strings.notes: US 0100/6 | RV043: voice: 老太婆 is the husband's address to his wife; US 'dear' and 'behind every experience' changed it

strings.zh: 我能够遇见你,{NEWLINE}是我人生中{CLEAR}最美好的故事,老头子。
strings.en: Meeting you is the most beautiful story{NEWLINE}of my life, old man.
strings.notes: US line rewritten: the zh is the old woman's reply to her husband (#6). | RV043: voice: 老头子 is the wife's address to her husband

strings.zh: 我是想在战斗前线{NEWLINE}工作而来的！{SCROLL}因为以前那份工作,{NEWLINE}我做饭、扫地、洗衣服,{CLEAR}都很擅长！
strings.en: I’ve come to the Battle Frontier to{NEWLINE}get a job!{SCROLL}Thanks to my previous job, I’m good{NEWLINE}at cooking, cleaning, and laundry!

strings.zh: 强即是弱,{NEWLINE}弱即是强。{SCROLL}这句话是别人教给我的,{SCROLL}虽然意思不太明白,{NEWLINE}但好像含义深刻,{CLEAR}我打算再思考一下。
strings.en: To be strong is to be weak.{NEWLINE}To be weak is to be strong.{SCROLL}Somebody told me that before.{NEWLINE}I don’t quite understand it yet,{CLEAR}but it sounds deep.{SCROLL}I’ll just give myself some time{NEWLINE}to figure it out.

strings.zh: 我在这里{NEWLINE}观察着那些认真地和{CLEAR}精灵在一起的人们,{CLEAR}就觉得自己一个人生活{CLEAR}实在是太傻了！{SCROLL}我也要再次认真地{NEWLINE}和精灵交心！
strings.en: Watching these people who care so much{NEWLINE}about Pokémon makes me feel foolish for{CLEAR}living all alone.{SCROLL}I’ll open my heart to Pokémon{NEWLINE}again, too!
strings.notes: US 0100/10 [D-2055 meaning-review-30: independently LLM-reviewed source-faithful correction; not human-approved.]

strings.zh: 大叔和精灵相遇{NEWLINE}已经过去４９年了……{SCROLL}啊！{SCROLL}几年几月几日{NEWLINE}都有记录在记事本上的,{CLEAR}但其中的页面撕破找不到了！{SCROLL}莫非是精灵给咬坏的？
strings.en: It’s been 49 years since this old guy{NEWLINE}first met Pokémon...{SCROLL}Oh!{SCROLL}I wrote down the exact date in my{NEWLINE}notebook, but that page got torn out,{CLEAR}and I can’t find it!{SCROLL}Could a Pokémon have chewed it up?
strings.notes: US 0100/11 | RV043: meaning: stale US; the notebook page with the date was torn out

strings.zh: 训练家要在关爱精灵的同时{CLEAR}让它进行战斗,{SCROLL}精灵就会信赖训练家,{CLEAR}全力以赴为你战斗。{SCROLL}这就是人类和精灵之间的信任。{SCROLL}这看上去虽然是理所当然的,{NEWLINE}却也是非常激动人心的事情！！
strings.en: If you care for your Pokémon while{NEWLINE}having it battle,{SCROLL}it will trust you and fight its hardest{NEWLINE}for you.{SCROLL}That’s the trust between people and{NEWLINE}Pokémon.{SCROLL}It may look like a given, but it’s{NEWLINE}actually really thrilling!!
strings.notes: US 0100/12 | RV043: meaning: stale US; Trainer cares for Pokémon while it battles, Pokémon then trusts and fights hard

strings.zh: 害怕失败,{NEWLINE}我们就将一无所成。{SCROLL}但是！{SCROLL}明明不可能赢的战斗,{NEWLINE}勉强让精灵们参加,{CLEAR}也说不上是勇气。{SCROLL}真正强大的训练家{NEWLINE}会平衡把握{CLEAR}这两者间的关系。
strings.en: If we fear failure, we’ll never{NEWLINE}accomplish anything.{SCROLL}But!{SCROLL}Forcing your Pokémon into a battle you{NEWLINE}can’t possibly win can’t be called{CLEAR}courage either.{SCROLL}Truly strong Trainers know how to{NEWLINE}balance the two.
strings.notes: US 0100/13 | RV043: addition: dropped US 'only make your Pokémon suffer'

strings.zh: 如果你想作为一般的{NEWLINE}训练家毕业的话,{CLEAR}至少记住以下这些话！{SCROLL}精灵的属性！{SCROLL}让其学会的技能！{SCROLL}让其佩戴的道具！{SCROLL}所有的都不能轻视！
strings.en: If you want to graduate from being{NEWLINE}a so-so Trainer, mark my words!{SCROLL}The Pokémon’s type!{SCROLL}The moves to be learned!{SCROLL}The items to be held!{SCROLL}You can’t overlook a single detail.

strings.zh: 赢了之后……{SCROLL}有的人会嘲笑失败的对手,{NEWLINE}有的人自满于自己的强大,{CLEAR}也有的人认为自己是世界第一,~{CLEAR}得意地手舞足蹈,{CLEAR}各种各样的人都有。{SCROLL}但我喜欢友善地对待失败的对手,{CLEAR}细心激励他的人！
strings.en: After a win...{SCROLL}some people laugh at the opponent they{NEWLINE}beat, some get smug about their own{CLEAR}strength, and some think they’re{CLEAR}number one in the world and dance{CLEAR}around in glee. There are all sorts.{SCROLL}But I like people who treat the{NEWLINE}opponent they beat kindly and take{CLEAR}care to encourage them!
strings.notes: US 0100/15 | RV043: omission: restored smugness and encouraging the loser

strings.zh: 你知道战斗前线的首领吗？{SCROLL}这战斗前线有５座设施,{CLEAR}你只要不断胜利,{CLEAR}首领训练家{CLEAR}就会现身！
strings.en: Do you know about the Frontier Brains?{SCROLL}The Battle Frontier has five facilities.{NEWLINE}As long as you keep winning, the Brains{CLEAR}will show up!
strings.notes: US 0100/16 | RV043: addition: dropped US 'They're out-of-this-world tough!'

strings.zh: 享受对战,{NEWLINE}互相帮助,{CLEAR}成为自己的朋友,{CLEAR}带着它去远方,{SCROLL}你不觉得精灵是种很奇妙的{CLEAR}生物吗？{SCROLL}我也想成为精灵啊！
strings.en: They let us enjoy battles, they help us{NEWLINE}out, they become our friends, and we{CLEAR}take them to faraway places...{SCROLL}Don’t you think Pokémon are amazing{NEWLINE}creatures?{SCROLL}I want to be a Pokémon too!
strings.notes: US 0100/17 | RV043: meaning: zh 'I want to become a Pokémon', not 'be like'; restored the question

strings.zh: 用租借的精灵对战的战斗工厂{CLEAR}这是个很需要精灵知识的地方,{SCROLL}在其他地方完全没有胜算的我{NEWLINE}在战斗工厂或许能行！
strings.en: At the Battle Factory, you battle with{NEWLINE}rental Pokémon, so you really need to{CLEAR}know a lot about Pokémon.{SCROLL}I don’t stand a chance at the other{NEWLINE}facilities, but I might do well here!
strings.notes: US 0100/18 [D-2056 meaning-review-30: independently LLM-reviewed source-faithful correction; not human-approved.]

strings.zh: 用喜欢的精灵以１ｖｓ１的形式{NEWLINE}进行战斗看看能打到什么地步。{CLEAR}这就是战斗舞台的规则,{CLEAR}在那里我的鲤鱼王{CLEAR}也有可能得第一呢！{SCROLL}喔！{NEWLINE}我突然充满干劲！
strings.en: Battle with your favorite Pokémon{NEWLINE}one-on-one and see how far you can{CLEAR}get. That’s the rule at the Battle Hall,{CLEAR}and there, even my Magikarp could take{CLEAR}first place!{SCROLL}Whoa! I’m suddenly all fired up!
strings.notes: US 0100/19; modernised from US 0100#19 | RV043: omission: restored 'favorite Pokémon' and 'see how far you get'

strings.zh: 人生多是沉浮不定,{NEWLINE}为以防万一{CLEAR}要随时带着救生圈。{SCROLL}这是我这５年来的人生中{NEWLINE}发现的{CLEAR}生存智慧！
strings.en: Life is full of ups and downs, so always{NEWLINE}keep a float ring with you, just in case.{SCROLL}That’s the survival wisdom I’ve found in{NEWLINE}these five years of my life!
